issue_context.body:

The new YouLess integration (thanks btw it works great!) does not provide support for long-term-statistics. As suggested on this page: https://www.home-assistant.io/more-info/statistics/, I'm opening a issue and forwarding the developers to: https://developers.home-assistant.io/docs/core/entity/sensor/#long-term-statistics

core-2021.8.0
